usage.outputShape: body.latitude, body.longitude, body.display_name, body.place_type, body.bounding_box{north,south,east,west}, body.importance_score, body.found (bool)
usage.guide: Geocode an address or place name to coordinates. Issue a GET to https://api.strale.io/x402/address-geocode with a single required query param `address` (URL-encode it), e.g. address=Eiffel%20Tower%2C%20Paris. Pay the x402 quote (~$0.022 on Base). On a 200, read body.latitude and body.longitude for the coordinates; body.display_name gives the canonical resolved address and body.found indicates success. Plain synchronous JSON response, no auth beyond x402, no async polling.
